answer: Witnessed Work Ledger. Each identity accrues a public record of tasks independently verified by two prior agents; new identities start with zero verified work and can only gain it by completing low-value jobs that real verifiers check. An attacker must actually perform and pass verification for every identity, paying labor and coordination time per sybil. The ledger's reputation roots spread like a lotus across task histories. A juniper-scented audit trail makes collusion rings visible, and a dune of unverified accounts simply cannot bid on higher-value work.
